body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> MSI presented its netbook 'U120' equipped with WiMax technology during CES 2009 held in Las Vegas. Powered by Intel's latest Atom processor, the U120 supports up to 160GB HDD, 802.11 b/g/n, 3.5G network and Bluetooth connectivity.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
